title: BLUFF: Benchmarking the Detection of False and Synthetic Content across 58 Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing detection performance (Macro-F1) and cross-lingual transfer capabilities between high-resource ('big-head') and low-resource ('long-tail') languages, as well as across linguistic typologies (genetic family, script, syntax).
Evaluating the distribution of human-written and machine-generated samples across 12 geographic regions and 331 source organizations to identify underrepresentation of specific global communities.
Analyzing the distribution of sentiment labels (positive, negative, neutral) in generated fake news compared to real news to quantify the 'negativity bias' characteristic of disinformation.
